title: Гражданин мира и выход на пробежку  (Citizen of the World and Heading Out to Jog)

segments.t: Amused by Kostya's predicament, Max cheerfully declares that he does not mind Rodion staying at the apartment—so long as Rodion sleeps in Kostya and Nastya's room. The next morning in the park, Chef Barinov shows up in a brand-new tracksuit and surprises Elena by actually appearing for their morning jog.
Пускай остается у нас.
Мы с Максом не против.
А ты убирай, в какой комнате будешь жить?
С вами.
Родион Сергеевич.
Прошу прощения.
Я гражданин мира, мне нечего скрывать.
Доброе утро.
Даже не думал, что вы придете.
Ну что, побежали?
Еще умолять будете, чтобы я остановился.
Да ладно вам.
Ну, вперед.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
Пускай остается у нас.

'Let him stay here with us.' Letting him stay here with them is how Max lays out the situation for Kostya. In Russian you say "by me" or "with us" rather than "I have", so the situation sits right with the person.
Мы с Максом не против.
'Max and I have no objection.' Kostya reminds Max that Max and he has no objection before the moment passes.
А ты убирай, в какой комнате будешь жить?

'So pick which room you are going to sleep in?' Questioning whether pick which room Kostya is going to sleep is how Rodion tests Kostya's story. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
С вами.
'In the room with you two.' With the shift and work in play, Max keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Родион Сергеевич.
'Rodion Sergeyevich.' Between the shift and the point, Kostya gives Max a quick, grounded response.
Прошу прощения.
'I beg your pardon.' Explaining that he begs Kostya's pardon lays the cards on the table for Kostya.
Я гражданин мира, мне нечего скрывать.
'I am a citizen of the world, I have nothing to hide.' Max mentions that he is a citizen of the world he has nothing to hide so Kostya sees what is at stake.
Доброе утро.
'Good morning.' Between the moment and the apartment, Kostya gives Max a quick, grounded response.
Даже не думал, что вы придете.

'I did not even think that you would actually show up.' Realizing that he did not even think that Kostya would actually show up changes how Rodion handles the situation. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Ну что, побежали?

'Well then, shall we run?' Over the work and the room, Max presses Kostya for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Еще умолять будете, чтобы я остановился.
'You will be begging me to stop before long.' Even though Max will be begging him to stop before long, Kostya keeps a steady face in front of Max.
Да ладно вам.
'Oh, come on now.' Rodion explains that Kostya should come on now, keeping his voice calm and direct. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Ну, вперед.
'All right, forward march.' With the conversation and morning in play, Max keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Пускай остается у нас.
Мы с Максом не против.
А ты убирай, в какой комнате будешь жить?
С вами.
Родион Сергеевич.
Прошу прощения.
Я гражданин мира, мне нечего скрывать.
Доброе утро.
Даже не думал, что вы придете.
Ну что, побежали?
Еще умолять будете, чтобы я остановился.
Да ладно вам.
Ну, вперед.

That wraps up this scene as max mischievously agrees to let Rodion stay in Kostya and Nastya's room, and the next morning Chef Barinov meets a surprised Elena in the park for their run. See you next time!
Хорошего дня!
